project_type: Node.js Express (ES modules) + Expo React Native mobile app + Vite React admin panel
build_system: npm scripts - no formal build step for backend (ES modules, no transpile), expo for mobile, vite for admin
test_framework: No test framework configured - backend package.json has 'echo Error: no test specified'
build_command: N/A - backend runs directly via node, no build step required
verification_instructions: AST/syntax validation via node --check for .js files. Verify TypeScript correctness via tsc --noEmit in mobile/admin directories. Manual code review for correctness.
setup_instructions: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY - cannot npm install. All dependencies already in node_modules.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot npm install, cannot access external registries. Must work with existing installed packages only. No Docker daemon available. Validation by AST parsing and code review only.
contribution_requirements: Commit directly to fix/final-stabilization branch. Multiple logical commits encouraged.

key_patterns.backend_modules: Each module has model.js, service.js, controller.js, routes.js, validation.js
key_patterns.config_storage: AppConfig model uses key-value store with mongoose.Schema.Types.Mixed for flexible config. Used for feed_recommendation_weights, auth_background_media.
key_patterns.socket_events: emitToUser(userId, eventName, payload) from backend/src/realtime/emitter.js. Mobile listens in socket.service.ts via socket.on(eventName).
key_patterns.push_service: expo-server-sdk based, handles chunking, receipt checking, token cleanup
key_patterns.admin_broadcast: BroadcastLog model tracks title, message, sentBy, recipientCount, pushesSent
key_patterns.mobile_state: Redux Toolkit - appSlice has unreadNotificationCount, socket.service.ts dispatches setUnreadCount

directory_structure: backend/src/modules/notifications/ - notification module (model, service, controller, routes, validation, broadcastLog). backend/src/realtime/ - socket server + emitter. backend/src/shared/services/ - pushService. backend/src/modules/admin/ - admin controller, appConfig model, routes. mobile/src/services/ - API service layer. mobile/src/store/slices/ - Redux state. mobile/src/screens/notifications/ - UI. admin/src/pages/ - admin panel pages.
